subject: Re: Demo request — shift to technical retreat + prework
messages:
From: Aline Duarte <aline@novosys.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@novosys.io>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Intro demo — need to convert to multi-team technical session

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the calendar invite for next week. Our execs just confirmed travel for that window and the stakeholders who need to evaluate feasibility are spread across Product, Platform, and our SRE team.

Rather than the 30–45m intro, would Redwood be open to converting this into a 2-hour technical session/retreat so we can:
- validate integration patterns (VPC, KMS)
- review latency/cost expectations for our 3 key flows
- get a short hands-on walkthrough of a sample prompt set

If possible we also want a short prework doc so our engineers can bring sample data and questions. Can you let me know availability the week of July 12 or July 19?

Appreciate it — Aline

Aline Duarte
Head of Platform Integrations, Novosys
aline@novosys.io | +1 415-555-0119

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro demo — need to convert to multi-team technical session

Hi Aline — thanks for the heads-up. We can absolutely run a 2-hour technical deep-dive instead of the short intro. That actually helps us get the right folks in the room.

Proposed approach:
- 30m architecture & routing (Redwood runtime, VPC/private options, KMS integration)
- 45m hands-on walkthrough (sample prompt flows, KV/prefix caching)
- 30m ops/SLAs/cost levers (batching, quantization recommendations)
- 15m next steps + action items

We can host on July 13, 14, 19, or 20 in the US morning (10:00–12:00 PT) to accommodate your engineering team. Please confirm which date works best.

I'm attaching a short \"prework template\" you can share with your team to gather sample prompts and data shapes — fills make the session much higher impact. Also cc'ing Marissa and Grace so they can confirm engineering capacity and whether we should bring an infra engineer for the KMS/VPC portion.

Attachments: novosys-prework-template.docx

—
Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199
